answer: Assign graders by lottery from a seed nobody controls, drawn only after answers are sealed. A sybil farm then can't steer its clones onto panels judging each other: most of its fake accounts land judging honest work, where a lazy mirror of the majority vote gets caught as noise. Gaming that needs control of nearly the whole network, the single vertex every panel passes through, and the canyon between "many accounts" and "that much control" is what keeps the attack unprofitable.
